notes: δέον ἐστίν is joined into one aligned unit on 'ought' rather than leaving the copula unrepresented; splitting them would leave one token with no English word at all, and rule 73's collapsed-pair test keeps the status aligned.
ἀναντιρρήτων → 'cannot be gainsaid' is headed on 'gainsaid' under rule 84's reasoning for a privative, the negation spelling only the alpha-privative.
The repeated infinitival 'to' before 'do' is an ordinary rule 7 helper on πράσσειν, as rule 40 has it for a repeated marker.
